name: Shinomiya Inori
source:
She was a sophomore at the same university as Ruri and a member of the same club, but she returned to Shigenmura partway through her studies. Later, she invites Ruri and the others to visit the village again.

She is serious, quiet, and has a mysterious air about her. As the village shrine maiden—the “Child of the Gods”—she was cherished by the villagers and grew up without want. Fulfilling that role is her very identity.

It is said that Inori can hear the voice of the “Mountain God.”
